prompt_inputs.goal: build muscle while reducing body fat from 18% to 15%
prompt_inputs.restrictions: paleolithic diet, some dairy is okay, no grains

solution_criteria: Meal plan is compact and fits within 1 day
Provides caloric intake supporting muscle gain with modest fat loss (approximately 300-500 calorie deficit)
Contains adequate protein (1.6-2.2g per kg body weight) distributed across meals
Includes whole foods suitable for a sedentary office worker transitioning to gym routine
task_description: Write a compact, consise, 1 day meal plan for someone who wants to build muscle and move down to 15% body fat from 18% body fat.
scenario: Testing with a sedentary office worker (minimal exercise baseline) transitioning to a structured gym routine, requiring calorie surplus management for muscle gain while maintaining modest deficit for fat loss
